_comment: Advisories scripts/ci/audit.sh pnpm may ignore. Every entry needs id (CVE or GHSA), reason and expires (YYYY-MM-DD); an expired entry fails the lane. Only an advisory with no fixed release reachable from our consumers belongs here — anything with a fix is pinned through pnpm.overrides in the root package.json instead (CLAUDE.md §9).

allow.reason: picomatch ReDoS on attacker-supplied extglob patterns (CVE-2026-112366). No fixed release exists: every version through the latest, 4.0.7, is affected. The only --prod paths are the mobile app's Expo build tooling (@expo/cli, metro-file-map, react-native codegen), which compile developer-written globs at build time and never match a glob supplied by a user. Remove this entry and pin the fix through pnpm.overrides once picomatch publishes one.
